topic: Unlocking Conic Sections: The Magic of Dandelin Spheres
target_audience: High school students interested in geometry and visual mathematics

sections.title: Prerequisite Warm-up: The Cutting Plane
lecture_lines: Meet the double cone and the cutting plane.
Conic sections emerge from this simple intersection.
Imagine slicing a carrot at various angles.
Circles, ellipses, parabolas, and hyperbolas are formed.
The angle determines the final geometric shape.
animations: Fade in a 3D double cone and a cutting plane, represented by a carrot icon for visual alignment. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/carrot.png] (Color: #FFFFFF)
Highlight the intersection curve as a circle initially. (Color: #FF00FF)
Rotate the plane to slice through one cone nappe. (Color: #FF9900)
Animate the shape transition into an ellipse. (Color: #00FFFF)
Show the resulting ellipse label with a bold highlight alongside the carrot icon. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/carrot.png] (Color: #FFFFFF)

sections.title: Introducing the Dandelin Spheres
lecture_lines: Meet Dandelin spheres inside our double cone.
They touch the cone in a circular ring.
They also touch our cutting plane perfectly.
animations: Highlight the two circular rings of tangency. (Color: #00FF00)
Show [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg] making contact points with the plane. (Color: #FF0000)

sections.title: Visualizing the Ellipse
lecture_lines: The plane cuts through one cone nappe.
Two spheres touch the cone and plane.
Distance sum to tangency points remains constant.
animations: Display lines connecting ellipse points to focal spheres. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg] (Color: #FFFFFF)
Trace the moving point and show segments labeled d1, d2. (Color: #FF9900)
Sum the segments to demonstrate constancy label. (Color: #FFFF00)

sections.title: Parabolas and Hyperbolas
lecture_lines: Angle changes create parabolas and hyperbolas.
Parallel edges create the unique parabola shape.
Cutting both nappes forms the beautiful hyperbola.
animations: Rotate the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg] parallel to a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cone.svg] edge. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Rotate the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg] steeper to cut both nappes of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cone.svg]. (Color: #FF0000)

sections.title: Summary and Geometric Elegance
lecture_lines: Dandelin spheres bridge 3D space to 2D geometry.
These shapes underpin our physical universe.
Mathematical elegance defines orbits and satellite dishes.
animations: Overlay all three conic sections side-by-side using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/telescope.svg] to represent the observation of these shapes. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Highlight Dandelin spheres near each section. (Color: #FF00FF)
Fade out all elements leaving only the core conic definitions represented by a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/satellite.svg]. (Color: #FFFFFF)
